title: CmdPal: Stop reloading clipboard entries that haven't changed
summary: The existing fork review loop converged after multiple fix rounds: the latest Copilot pass returned zero new comments and the fork has zero unresolved Copilot threads. The live upstream head still lacks the validated fork corrections for clipboard format precedence, teardown ordering, stale refresh reporting, stale metadata notification, and cross-thread GetItems serialization, so a current-head non-blocking review is drafted.

proposed_comments.title: Preserve text-first clipboard format precedence
proposed_comments.body:
This now loads the bitmap even when the same clipboard item also exposes text. `ClipboardListItem` checks `IsImage` before `IsText`, so entries containing both formats change from the existing text-first behavior to image presentation and command handling. Please load the bitmap only when `text` is null so the optimization does not change the established format precedence.

**Severity:** `medium`

confidence.rationale: The exact upstream code loads both formats and the downstream item checks image before text; the converged fork fix changes only the bitmap condition and was reviewed by Copilot.

proposed_comments.title: Drain the cache before disposing the clipboard source
proposed_comments.body:
Please dispose and drain `_cache` before disposing `_source`. A refresh may already be queued on the worker when teardown begins; releasing the source first allows that refresh to enter `ReadAsync` after the source is disposed, producing an `ObjectDisposedException` and a user-visible clipboard load failure during normal page teardown.

**Severity:** `medium`
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The required ordering spans the asynchronous cache and source lifetime, while the current diff does not provide a safe single RIGHT-side range for the complete teardown correction.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: The required ordering spans the asynchronous cache and source lifetime, while the current diff does not provide a safe single RIGHT-side range for the complete teardown correction.

confidence.rationale: The current DisposeAsync implementation releases the source before awaiting cache disposal; the converged fork correction reverses that order and directly addresses the queued-refresh failure path.

proposed_comments.title: Suppress errors from superseded refreshes
proposed_comments.body:
Please gate the status notification and logging with the same current-refresh check used for `_refreshFailed`. A superseded or disposed refresh can currently report a failure after a newer refresh has succeeded, leaving the user with a spurious “failed to load” status. Only the still-observed refresh should publish the error.

**Severity:** `medium`
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The correction must coordinate the locked current-refresh test with the user-visible reporting side effects; the current diff has no safe single RIGHT-side range for that complete change.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: The correction must coordinate the locked current-refresh test with the user-visible reporting side effects; the current diff has no safe single RIGHT-side range for that complete change.

confidence.rationale: The current catch block always reports the exception, while the fork fix records a report flag only for the still-current refresh and emits status/logging conditionally.

proposed_comments.title: Notify consumers after concurrent metadata refresh
proposed_comments.body:
Please make the file-details refresh notification safe against a concurrent `Lazy` replacement. `IsValueCreated` can be false for the new lazy while another thread still holds and evaluates the old lazy, so this method can return without raising `PropertyChanged` and consumers can retain stale metadata. Notify unconditionally after replacing the lazy, or serialize the getter and reset operation.

**Severity:** `medium`
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The race is split between the lazy replacement and the details getter in ClipboardListItem; no single current RIGHT-side range safely expresses the required synchronization.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: The race is split between the lazy replacement and the details getter in ClipboardListItem; no single current RIGHT-side range safely expresses the required synchronization.

confidence.rationale: Copilot identified the `IsValueCreated`/Details race on the converged fork, and the fork correction removes the conditional notification so concurrent consumers cannot miss the update.

proposed_comments.title: Serialize GetItems across notification threads
proposed_comments.body:
This reentrancy check is thread-static, but `ItemsChanged` can be raised from a different background thread while the initial `GetItems` call is still executing. That permits overlapping provider calls; a provider that holds a lock while publishing the notification and waits for the publisher thread can deadlock, and the surrounding code explicitly assumes providers do not support concurrent `GetItems` calls. Track an active reservation per view-model instance under `_fetchStateLock` and defer cross-thread notifications until the active call completes; make the reservation/deferred transition atomic so no refresh can be lost or run concurrently.

**Severity:** `high`

confidence.rationale: The current implementation uses `[ThreadStatic]` state, while the converged fork required several rounds to make cross-thread reservation, deferred consumption, and release atomic; the resulting zero-comment Copilot pass confirms the fork correction.
